purpose: Prevent normal CI and merge-queue waiting from being treated as a campaign-wide blocker while preserving fail-closed release authority.

authorities.queue_truth: GitHub mergeQueueEntry for the exact head SHA
authorities.release_truth: Cloud Run latestReadyRevisionName plus revision-level NIRMANA_DEPLOYED_SHA
authorities.authority_truth: protected ownership detector and environment-bound release authorization

states.ci_running: Monitor and continue independent ready work.
states.merge_queue_wait: A real queue entry exists; do not cancel or mark the campaign blocked.
states.merge_ready: All required checks are green and no queue entry exists; queue the exact head.
states.merged_release_pending: The protected merge exists but the deployed revision is not yet proven.
states.release_authority_pending: Only the release dependency cone awaits its provisioned authority broker.
states.release_running: Observe the protected exact-SHA workflow; never cancel it.
states.live_revision_unverified: Read the deployed revision directly before proceeding to acceptance.
states.acceptance_running: Run the frozen three-door product matrix and preserve all receipts.
states.blocked_authority: Record the absent external authority precisely while independent work continues.

required_stall_evidence: no meaningful transition past hard threshold
two observations at least confirmation_minutes apart

native_surrogate.lifecycle: The surrogate returns a bounded decision packet and exits; the original task model and effort resume execution.

hard_boundary: A surrogate may resolve in-charter ambiguity but cannot create credentials, grant IAM, or substitute for an unprovisioned external authority.
